language.title: App language
language.body: You can change it any time in You.

location.title: Where are you?
location.body: Prayer times follow your location. It stays on your device.
location.denied: Location is off, and that’s fine. Choose your city: everything works the same.
location.failed: We couldn’t find your location. Choose your city instead.
location.noResults: No city by that name. Try another spelling.
location.methodNote: Chosen for {country}. You can change it any time.

start.title: Where are you today?
start.caption: This stays on your device. There is no wrong answer.

reminders.title: A gentle call at each prayer
reminders.body: A reminder when each prayer comes in, in the sound you prefer. You can change it for each prayer.
reminders.denied: Reminders are off. You can turn them on later in your phone’s settings.

simpleView.title: Larger and simpler?
simpleView.body: Simple view shows today’s prayer times and one large button.
